name: Jockstrap
label: Rough Trade
lede: Georgia Ellery brought poems and a jazz violin; Taylor Skye brought a laptop and a habit of not leaving a sound alone. They picked the name Jockstrap for shock value, then went on to a 21-piece student string section, a Mercury Prize shortlist and one laptop that nearly left a restaurant without them.

eras.title: Two conservatoire students, one set of poems
eras.text: Georgia Ellery studied jazz violin at London's Guildhall School of Music and Drama; Taylor Skye studied electronic music. She asked him to produce her poems-turned-songs, and the duo was a going concern by the end of 2017.

years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview
years.h: Guildhall puts a jazz violinist and an electronic composer in one building
years.p: [[Georgia Ellery|8994432f-57d9-4fe6-adc1-db6674a5fff4]] and [[Taylor Skye|8f9e08b1-545d-499b-b48b-dc8c5a5f037a]] meet at the Guildhall School of Music and Drama in 2016. They don't work together until September 2017, when she asks him to produce her songs.
years.xp:
The name was picked for shock value and memorability, according to Wikipedia.

The pattern stuck: Ellery writes, often starting from poems, and sends the songs to Skye to produce, as Rolling Stone described their workflow.

years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview
years.h: "I Want Another Affair" is the first single
years.p: It arrives in late 2017, a few months before the duo's first live show in March 2018.

years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · The Quietus: Moments Of Hyperreal Intimacy
years.h: A 21-piece student string section plays on the debut EP
years.p: Love Is the Key to the City comes out on Kaya Kaya Records. Songs like "Hayley" and "Charlotte" started as poems about Ellery's time at Guildhall.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists the EP as the duo's debut release on Kaya Kaya Records. The Quietus interviewed them about it in the week it came out.

eras.title: A gallery instead of a video shoot
eras.text: A remix EP with homemade videos, a bigger label and a record that pulled in noise and hip-hop. Then a pandemic.

years.h: Skye remixes the debut EP and Ellery directs the videos herself
years.p: Lost My Key in the <3 Club <3 reworks Love Is the Key to the City in April 2019.

years.h: Ellery joins Black Country, New Road on violin and vocals
years.p: Wikipedia places her arrival shortly after 2018, while Jockstrap carries on alongside.
years.xp: Her Wikipedia page lists her on the band's albums For the First Time (2021), Ants from Up There (2022) and Forever Howlong (2025).

years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · PopMatters: Jockstrap's Wicked City
years.h: The first Warp record arrives with the venues shut
years.p: Wicked City pulls in electro-noise and experimental hip-hop, including "Robert" with the Arizona group [[Injury Reserve|4c4fa077-b351-4558-9013-b31e1fbd1d24]], who took Jockstrap on their UK and Ireland tour.
years.xp:
With venues shut, Jockstrap skipped conventional videos and built a virtual exhibition at implied.gallery. Ellery also improvised for 15 minutes with [[Jamie xx|d1515727-4a93-4c0d-88cb-d7a9fce01879]] on BBC Radio 3's Late Junction.

PopMatters called the EP "an unfolding of boundaries" in July 2020.

eras.title: Rough Trade and a plain grey record
eras.text: Rough Trade takes over, three years of songs come together, and Jockstrap lands on critics' lists for the year.

years.src: Pitchfork: Jockstrap Sign to Rough Trade · Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview
years.h: Jockstrap leave Warp for Rough Trade and announce it with "50/50"
years.p: The new single is the one song on the album that began as a Skye beat rather than an Ellery poem.
years.xp: Pitchfork reported the signing the same day.

years.h: Ellery appears on Black Country, New Road's Ants from Up There
years.p: The album arrives in the year Isaac Wood leaves the band, and Ellery shares lead vocals afterwards.

years.big: "That's what I want to hear: the surprise."
years.src: Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview · Wikipedia: I Love You Jennifer B
years.h: A slip of the tongue stays on "Concrete Over Water"
years.p: A mispronunciation on the single became the final take, Rolling Stone reported. Ellery was talking about unexpected production choices.
years.xp: The single was followed by "Glasgow" on 14 June.

years.h: Slowthai runs down the thief who took Skye's laptop
years.p: The laptop, with the album on it, was snatched at a North London vegan Chinese restaurant. Rapper [[Slowthai|333e76b4-9606-4fd3-bcb3-8e7660bb4d96]] chased the thief and got it back.
years.xp: Rolling Stone reports that Skye's liner note reads: "Ty chased the guy down and got the laptop back."

years.src: Wikipedia: I Love You Jennifer B · The Quietus: Tell Them How You Feel
yt: Live at Rough Trade East, 9 Sept 2022
years.h: I Love You Jennifer B lands, and Pitchfork gives it an 8.4
years.p: Pitchfork ranked the debut No. 15 of 2022; Metacritic lists 89 from 15 critics.
years.xp:
Wikipedia reports it entered the UK Albums Chart at No. 57 and reached No. 3 on the UK Independent Albums Chart. DIY ranked it No. 1 of 2022, Clash No. 3, The Line of Best Fit No. 6.

The album runs ten tracks over 44 minutes, with a plain grey cover and stickers for fans to customize. On release day the duo played an in-store set at Rough Trade East.

years.src: NME: Jockstrap share cameo-laden music video
yt: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, 2024
years.h: The "Greatest Hits" video puts a feuding pop duo on trial
years.p: Aidan Zamiri directs, with cameos from [[Jamie xx|d1515727-4a93-4c0d-88cb-d7a9fce01879]] and Don Letts and Ellery as the judge's clerk.

eras.title: Shortlisted
eras.text: The debut gets its official honour, and Skye hands the songs to remixers.

years.src: BrooklynVegan: Mercury Prize 2023 shortlist · Wikipedia: Jockstrap
yt: Concrete Over Water at the Mercury Prize 2023
years.h: Twelve albums make the 2023 Mercury Prize shortlist, Jennifer B among them
years.p: The ceremony is at Hammersmith Apollo on 7 September, and Jockstrap play "Concrete Over Water" there.
years.xp: Jockstrap also played "Concrete Over Water" at Glastonbury 2023.

years.h: Skye leads production on the remix album I<3UQTINVU
years.p: Rough Trade releases the remix of I Love You Jennifer B on 3 November 2023.
